name: Husam al-Dosari
bio: A contemporary physician and poet, he is identified by Alqimmah Studio as a consultant in paediatrics, paediatric endocrinology and diabetes. In his teaching poem on diabetes he brings a doctor’s eye to a sick child’s bedside and tells the story of how insulin reached patients. Khalid al-Sharafi has also recorded his poems on desire and growing older, “Is the Heart Taken Captive?” and “The Summit of Life”.
